description:
Export P6 runs for model fitting and kernel checks without the raw ULog (config p6.export).

Per run export/<run directory name>/:
  trace.csv.gz  one row per active RAPTOR inference (research_memory KIND_STEP, RAPTOR owns the motors), from the setup
                entry to the N->C (takeoff and landing are classic and omitted). Columns:
    t_s, px4_us          gyro-sample time of the RAPTOR cycle; t_s relative to the run's time origin (summary 'time_origin')
    ep_u, ep_w, ev_u, ev_w           UNCLIPPED position / velocity error (vehicle - RAPTOR target), horizontal, in the
                                     motion-axis frame: u along the planned motion axis, w = u rotated +90 deg (to the
                                     right, NED) -- a fixed horizontal rotation of the target-yaw frame
    ep_u_clip, ep_w_clip, ev_u_clip, ev_w_clip   the clipped error the network saw (research_memory.policy_input [0:2],
                                     [12:14], target-yaw FLU frame) rotated into the same u/w frame
    ep_f_clip, ep_l_clip, ev_f_clip, ev_l_clip   the same clipped inputs as seen (target-yaw frame: forward, left);
                                     clipping acts per axis in THIS frame (+-0.5 m, +-1.0 m/s)
    ep_f, ep_l, ev_f, ev_l           unclipped errors in the target-yaw frame (forward, left)
    ep_z, ev_z                       unclipped vertical errors (NED, down positive)
    a_u, a_w, a_z                    vehicle acceleration (vehicle_local_position ax, ay, az of the sample RAPTOR used,
                                     i.e. the EKF2 output acceleration, NED), horizontal projected on u/w
    v_u, v_w                         vehicle velocity on u/w (same sample)
    tilt_deg                         vehicle_attitude (latest at or before the cycle)
    alt_loss_m                       altitude below the altitude at the time origin (positive = lower)
    target_yaw_rad, target_mode      RAPTOR's target: external (latest external setpoint read), t0_capture (zero-velocity
                                     capture hold, RTGT=0), t1_profile (speed-matched capture / T1 profile row)
    gap_active                       1 between the last setpoint reception before a planned interruption and the first after
    recon_ok                         1 when the reconstruction matched the vehicle-state sample and a target
  summary.json  run identity, outcome, maxima, events with the unclipped state just before and at/after each event,
                resume jumps with the P5 predictions, reconstruction residual.
export/manifest.json lists every exported run (updated in place: one entry per run name).

Reconstruction (validated per run on the unclipped components of policy_input, residual reported): vehicle state =
vehicle_local_position sample named by research_timing.local_position_sample; target = the external setpoint RAPTOR read
(raptor_status reception cycles; for a cycle without a raptor_status row the latest logged setpoint counts as read unless
the next status row reads it) or RAPTOR's research_target capture / T1 profile row of a later cycle.

p7.description:
Export P7 runs in the P6 format (tools/p6_export.py; config p7.export) plus the rate-limited recovery.

Per run export/<run directory name>/:
  trace.csv.gz  the P6 columns (see tools/p6_export.py; same definitions, same reconstruction from RAPTOR's own inputs and
                the same validation against research_memory.policy_input), with target_mode 'recovery' in cycles where the
                network observed the virtual target (research_recovery STEP row of that cycle), plus:
    vt_active                    1 when the network observed the virtual target in this cycle
    tgt_p_u, tgt_p_w             position of the target the network observed (external setpoint / capture / T1 profile /
                                 virtual target) relative to the line centre (RAPTOR's hover capture), on u / w
    tgt_v_u, tgt_v_w             its velocity on u / w
    traj_p_u, traj_v_u           the original time-parameterized trajectory at this cycle (latest logged setpoint row
                                 advanced by its velocity; exact on the cruise and inside interruptions), relative to the
                                 line centre
    p_u, p_w                     vehicle position (the sample RAPTOR used) relative to the line centre
  summary.json  the P6 summary plus events 'recovery_start' / 'recovery_end' (with reason) and a 'recovery' list per resume:
                times of capture, resume, recovery start and end, catch-up duration (end CONVERGED - start), the target
                jump the network saw, and the lag behind the original trajectory over the 6 s after the resume (maximum and
                value at the window end; p7-metrics lag block).
export/manifest.json: the P6 manifest, entries added per run (export_script recorded per entry); top-level 'p7' block.

p8.description:
Export P8 runs in the P6 format (tools/p6_export.py; same reconstruction from RAPTOR's own inputs, same validation
against research_memory.policy_input, same column definitions) plus the vertical channel and the jump events.

A (identification, kind p6_ident). Per run export/<run directory name>/:
  trace.csv.gz  one row per active RAPTOR inference, the P6 columns (see tools/p6_export.py) plus:
    alt_m                altitude above the local origin (-z of the vehicle_local_position sample RAPTOR used)
    v_z                  vertical velocity of that sample (vz, NED, down positive)
    action_mean          mean of the 4 network outputs of this RAPTOR cycle (research_timing.action, [-1, 1])
    motor_cmd_mean       mean of the 4 motor commands with this cycle's sample time (actuator_motors.control, [0, 1];
                         empty when the log has no actuator_motors row for the sample)
    p_u, p_w             vehicle position (the sample RAPTOR used) relative to the line centre (RAPTOR's hover capture)
    tgt_p_u, tgt_p_w     position of the target RAPTOR used, relative to the line centre
  summary.json  the P6 summary plus 'p8' (p8-metrics p8 block: jump timing and size, realized cruise, lag and catch-up,
                vertical maxima, task criterion) and the event 'jump' (first RAPTOR cycle on the jumped setpoint).
B (test campaigns, kind p5_gap). Per run export/<run directory name>/:
  trace.csv.gz  the P6 columns plus alt_m, v_z, action_mean, motor_cmd_mean (6 significant digits), only [last reception before the first interruption - 1 s, first reception after the last
                interruption + 6 s] (t_s = 0 at that last reception); rows within +-1 s of an event (each in-flight capture
                and each resume) at the native RAPTOR rate, the others thinned to 50 Hz (first row per 20 ms bucket);
                at most 150 kB per run: written with 6 significant digits; if larger, 5 digits; if still larger, every
                second native row near the events (recorded in summary trace.size_fallback); a larger trace is an error
  summary.json  campaign (method, system under test, seed), round k, case name, case, windows, budget (pre_gap_s,
                post_gap_s, budget check against p8_space.budget), Gazebo seed, primary failure (frozen flight outcome and
                reasons), task criterion (max tilt >= 45 deg or max altitude loss > 1 m), max tilt and its time, max
                altitude loss, every capture and resume (PX4 time, t_s, state before / after), gap_timing audit result,
                infra_rerun, the reconstruction check
export/p8_b_results.csv: one row per B run flown (campaign, method, sut, seed, k, name, fail_primary, fail_task,
  max_tilt_deg, max_alt_loss_m, infra_rerun); an infrastructure / evidence failure that was rerun has empty result fields.
export/manifest.json: the P6 manifest, entries added per run (export_script recorded per entry); top-level 'p8' block.
